faqs.question: Why should I choose custom web development?
faqs.answer: Custom development gives you a website built specifically around your business requirements, offering greater flexibility, scalability, and control.

faqs.question: What types of websites do you develop?
faqs.answer: We develop business websites, e-commerce stores, custom web applications, and scalable solutions tailored to your business needs.

faqs.question: Which technologies do you use for web development?
faqs.answer: We work with modern technologies including PHP, Laravel, Node.js, React, and other tools based on project requirements.

faqs.question: Can you redesign or upgrade my existing website?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. We can redesign, optimize, and upgrade existing websites to improve performance, usability, and functionality.

faqs.question: How long does it take to develop a website?
faqs.answer: The timeline depends on the project's size and requirements. A standard business website can typically be completed within a few weeks.

faqs.question: Do you provide website maintenance and support?
faqs.answer: Yes. We offer ongoing maintenance and support to keep your website secure, updated, and performing smoothly.
